name: Call of Water

angles.text: As a shaman, you commune with primal elements and cleanse tainted water spirits. This rite reminds you of your enduring duty to balance nature.
As an Alliance member, you find the manifestation in Westfall, where local spirits endure the creeping blight touching the land.

faq.answer: In Westfall, you face a spiritual trial against corrupt spirits. A sacred invocation drives them back with radiant light, freeing the troubled waters so you can speak with a Minor Manifestation of Water.

aliases: where is the minor manifestation of water
faq.answer: The Minor Manifestation of Water appears in Westfall after the corrupt spirits nearby are subdued and dispelled. It waits to speak with those who aided the waters.
faq.q: Where can the Minor Manifestation of Water be found?

faq.answer: When the invocation ends, brilliant light scatters the corrupt spirits. Their tainted essence unravels into ash as the water hisses into gentle mist.
faq.q: What happens when the corrupted spirits are cleansed?

faq.answer: The immediate corruption ebbs, but the elemental warns that the land's vitality continues to wane. Mortals still bear the enduring duty of protecting life.
faq.q: Is the land fully restored after completing the task?

aliases: who can do call of water
faq.answer: You are called to cleanse the spirits and shoulder the duty of protecting dwindling life. The manifestation thanks your class for stepping forward.
faq.q: Who is called upon to assist the manifestation?

faq.answer: Corrupt spirits have disturbed Westfall's natural waters. Their precise origin is unclear, but their malevolent presence saps the area's living vitality.
faq.q: Why were the water spirits corrupted in Westfall?

sections.body: Corrupt spirits disturb Westfall's waters and their natural balance. You speak sacred words, and radiant light scatters the restless essences into ash and quiet mist.
sections.title: Cleansing the Tainted Waters

sections.body: Once the corrupt spirits are driven back, a Minor Manifestation of Water can emerge. It warns that the land's vital energies still wane, and that preserving life demands constant care.
sections.title: The Spirit's Warning

summary: In Westfall, you drive restless spirits from the waters before a Minor Manifestation of Water can speak with you.
attribution: In-game quest text: Call of Water
